style_when: the story is a product, a device, a price or a market for a thing the reader could buy — an appliance, a panel, a router, a robot arm
prompt: Studio product photograph, 85mm medium telephoto lens, shallow depth of field. An asymmetric composition featuring two distinct, heavy brushed-metal processor compute modules resting on a textured dark basalt surface. The larger module features dense matte-black cooling fins, while the smaller module is sleek polished aluminum. They are physically bridged by a thick, glowing amber fiber-optic data cable. Softbox key light with visible falloff casting long contact shadows across the studio surface. High-contrast, premium editorial standard, clean geometric layout with generous negative space.
negative_prompt: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, garbled UI, fonts, typography
rationale: A studio product shot isolates the hardware components, allowing the viewer to focus on the physical separation of the two distinct processing units and the heavy data bridge connecting them.
cue: two different machines inside one request
subject: two distinct brushed-metal processor modules connected by a thick glowing data bridge cable
core_thesis: Splitting the prefill and decode phases of AI requests into separate hardware pools maximizes throughput, with the key-value cache serving as the necessary bridge between them.
